epa_ghgrp.name: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program
epa_ghgrp.measurement: Reported, including calculations from fuel use
epa_ghgrp.caveat: Partial US facility footprint. Keep direct emitters separate from suppliers and injection; 2023 is the configured study cutoff.

epa_campd.name: EPA Clean Air Markets Program Data
epa_campd.measurement: Power-sector emissions reports, including continuous monitoring
epa_campd.caveat: Power-sector coverage only. Current-year observations may be partial; the owner-name allocation does not apply equity shares.

egrid.name: EPA eGRID
egrid.coverage: US power plants; retained snapshot labeled 2023
egrid.caveat: Only matched plants are included. Operator/utility attribution differs from equity ownership; do not add overlapping GHGRP and CAMPD totals.

sec_xbrl.name: SEC EDGAR XBRL frames
sec_xbrl.caveat: Revenue tags and fiscal periods differ. Revenue is global while the emissions numerator is a partial US footprint.

sbti.name: Science Based Targets initiative
sbti.license: Attribution required; verify source terms for reuse
sbti.measurement: Company commitments and externally validated targets
sbti.caveat: A target is not an achieved reduction. Statuses are evaluated against the build year and differ by target type.

epa_tri.name: EPA Toxics Release Inventory
epa_tri.caveat: Mass totals do not account for toxicity or exposure. Reporting thresholds and parent-name matching limit coverage.

osha_ita.name: OSHA Injury Tracking Application, Form 300A
osha_ita.access: Open; HTTP headers may be required
osha_ita.caveat: Hours and cases can contain reporting errors. Retain denominators and review flags; industry exposure differs.

epa_echo.name: EPA ECHO Enforcement and Compliance History
epa_echo.coverage: Matched US facilities; rolling three-year compliance history
epa_echo.caveat: Linked through GHGRP FRS IDs. Detection and enforcement differ; absence of a matched record does not establish compliance.

eia_923.name: EIA Form 923, via PUDL and API
eia_923.access: Open PUDL mirror; API key for EIA
eia_923.caveat: Useful for physical denominators and cross-checks. Boundaries and reporting periods must align.

esg_snapshot.name: Historical Sustainalytics ESG risk ratings via Yahoo mirror
esg_snapshot.caveat: Never used in the climate score. Not contemporaneous with 2023 results; its presence does not establish redistribution rights.

sp500_master.name: S&P 500 constituents
sp500_master.coverage: 503 securities / 500 CIKs in the retained snapshot
sp500_master.caveat: Membership is a snapshot, not a historical index universe. Multiple share classes share a CIK.

pudl.name: PUDL, Catalyst Cooperative
pudl.coverage: Processed EIA, EPA, and SEC data
pudl.caveat: An additional processing layer can introduce errors. Pin releases for reproducibility.

pudl_sec_ex21.name: SEC 10-K Exhibit 21 ownership, via PUDL
pudl_sec_ex21.coverage: Subsidiary records in the configured PUDL release
pudl_sec_ex21.caveat: Names may be abbreviated and ownership percentages incomplete. The active resolver uses curated mappings; this catalog entry is not proof of a complete historical crosswalk.

sec_dera.name: SEC companyfacts FY2024, prepared by Janis
sec_dera.caveat: Debt tags vary; missing research and development expense does not mean zero. Detailed filing references are retained in the team input.

dol_whd.name: DOL Wage and Hour Division enforcement
dol_whd.caveat: No CIK. Legal/trade-name attribution can include independent franchises. No match is missing evidence, not zero violations.

sec_sd.name: SEC Form SD conflict-minerals filings, prepared by Janis
sec_sd.coverage: Team filing-status snapshot; see original filing dates
sec_sd.caveat: Filing alone says nothing about responsible sourcing. The historical 2025 output label covers an input window containing later filing dates.

wba.name: World Benchmarking Alliance company profiles, prepared by Janis
wba.license: CC BY 4.0; credit World Benchmarking Alliance
wba.caveat: Disclosure-dependent and not independent across benchmarks. Near-constant fields provide little ranking information.
